text: dsh-research-writing 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术写作 bundle，通过 patch 将 dsh-lit-search 与 dsh-latex-guard 注册到同一插件中。它覆盖文献检索与相关文献扩展、GB/T 7714、APA 和 BibTeX 引文整理，以及 BibTeX 清理、引用核对和 LaTeX 编译检查。技能说明还提供论文引用指南和期刊名单参考入口，适合撰写论文、学位论文或维护 LaTeX 项目的用户。安装要求 Node.js 20 或更高版本；无需额外配置密钥。

dsh-research-writing bundles literature search, citation tools, and LaTeX/BibTeX checks for DeepSeek Harness. Its skill outlines search, citation formatting, bibliography cleanup, citation audits, and compilation, with a citation guide and journal-list data. Requires Node.js 20+.
想把论文文献检索、引用格式整理和 LaTeX 检查放进一个 DSH 写作流程。
有没有工具能帮我找相关论文并整理成 BibTeX 引用？
I need help checking citations and compiling a LaTeX paper from my DSH workflow.
dsh-research-writing 的功能「学术写作工具组合」：在 DSH 中同时注册文献检索与 LaTeX/BibTeX guard 插件；技能流程列出检索、引用生成、BibTeX 整理、引用核对和编译检查。
dsh-research-writing 的功能「引用与期刊参考指南」：技能要求论文综述和引用决策时先读随包提供的引用指南，并为期刊/会议名单判断指向随包期刊白名单数据。

Research writing bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): literature search + citations + BibTeX cleanup + LaTeX compile checks, in one install.

dsh-research-writing README · What's inside：| Plugin | Tools |
|---|---|
| [dsh-lit-search](https://github.com/Flan246/dsh-lit-search) | `lit_search` / `lit_cite` / `lit_bib` / `lit_related` — Crossref + OpenAlex literature search, GB/T 7714 / APA / BibTeX citations (incl. arXiv preprints) |
| [dsh-latex-guard](https://github.com/Flan246/dsh-latex-guard) | `latex_check` / `bib_lint` / `bib_fill` / `cite_audit` — latexmk compile checks with engine auto-detection, BibTeX lint/fill, citation audit |

dsh-research-writing README · Citation guide (new in 0.2.0)：The bundle now ships `skill/citation-guide.md`: a Chinese-language citation decision guide for undergraduate/novice paper writers — how many references to cite, which papers to prioritize (classics / top venues / recent work), a three-round search strategy, GB/T 7714 ordering rules, footnote vs. endnote vs. bibliography, and a field-tested pitfall list. The bundle's SKILL.md points agents to it for literature-review and reference-selection tasks.

dsh-research-writing README · Journal whitelist (new in 0.3.0)：`data/journal-whitelist.json`: curated economics/management + computer science venue whitelist with official sources and list versions (CSSCI 2025-2026, PKU Core 2023, CCF 2022, CAS journal divisions). Agents should check this file instead of guessing venue quality. `scripts/check-journal-lists.py` re-checks official list versions quarterly (local use only).

dsh-research-writing README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-research-writing
```

Both plugins are pulled in as dependencies and registered automatically. Do not install this bundle together with the standalone plugins in the same profile (the rows would duplicate).

dsh-research-writing README · Without dsh：Each plugin also ships a standalone CLI and a SKILL.md:

```bash
npx dsh-lit-search search "mixture of experts" -n 5
npx dsh-lit-search cite 10.1038/nature14539 -s gbt7714
npx dsh-latex-guard check ./my-paper main.tex
npx dsh-latex-guard bib-fill refs.bib --write
